description: We are AstroFlame, a team of enthusiastic engineering students from Bangladesh passionate about space science, AI, machine learning, scientific research, and innovative technology. Through FlameExpo, we aim to make NASA's microgravity combustion research data more accessible and meaningful. We welcome curious, creative, and collaborative participants interested in Python, data science, AI/ML, physics, web development, UI/UX, and scientific visualization. Join us to learn, innovate, and explore beyond boundaries!
